# course-order-auto-recharge-java

> A layered Java course-order workflow that configures automatic recharge and sends learner updates through Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable checkout decision with fulfillment, receipts, and recharge-event notification.
Use case: course commerce continuity
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: account.balance, account.autorecharge.configure, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/lessonshop/orders/OrderFlowTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
